newsitem.title: USA: Federal Reserve guarded despite ideal economy- NYT.
newsitem.headline: Federal Reserve guarded despite ideal economy- NYT.

text.p: Federal Reserve policy makers are unlikely to change interest rates next month, but some agency officials are guarded despite steady growth, low inflation and low unemployment, the New York Times said on Tuesday. The paper said four Reserve governors said in interviews and speeches last week that they were likely to move quickly to raise rates if wages or prices accelerate later this year.

Factors that could affect the economy include rising levels of consumer debt, a possible agreement to balance the federal budget and whether cuts in health care inflation can be sustained, the paper quoted Fed officials as saying.
